ROW.COLUMN: (ML/EN) Known Remitter/Beneficiary Names in Checks, Monetary Instruments

This scenario identifies possible money laundering or fraud involving checks or monetary instruments with recurring remitters, beneficiaries, or both. This activity can be evidence of attempts to structure deposits and move funds back and forth between accounts in an effort to hide their origin. Also, it can be indicative of a fraud scheme.

with mi_view as (SELECT * FROM @MINER@.MI_TRXN tr WHERE (@ALL_TRXN_CDS = 'Y' OR tr.src_sys_cd IN (@INCL_SRC_CD)) and tr.TRXN_BASE_AM >= @Min_Individual_Trans_Amt -- Allows to exclude small transactions and tr.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE <= (select cl.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and tr.MANTAS_ISSUE_DATE > (select add_days(cl.CLNDR_DT, - @Lookback) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select cl.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and tr.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(cl.CLNDR_DT, - @Lookback) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PURP_CD = 'GENERAL' and tr.MANTAS_TRXN_PRDCT_CD in (@Incl_MI_Trxn_Prdct_Type_Lst) and (@Include_Trusted_Trans_FL = 'Y' or COALESCE(tr.TRSTD_TRXN_FL,'N') ='N') ),
--pair activity pairs as ( select pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as Receiver_Seq_Id , pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM as Receiver_Name , pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as Sender_Seq_Id , pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_NM as Sender_Name , pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB as Effctv_Risk , t.Actvy_Risk , t.Pair_Trans_Am , t.HR_AM , t.PASS_THRU_AM , t.LRF_AM , t.Data_Dump_Date , t.Clndr_Dt , case when pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null then COALESCE(t.Sender_Id, rownum) else null end as Other_Id_Orig , case when pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null then 1 else 0 end as Id_Driven_Orig , case when pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.Sender_Id is null then 1 else 0 end as Nm_Driven_Orig , case when pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null then COALESCE(t.Receiver_Id, rownum) else null end as Other_Id_Bene , case when pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null then 1 else 0 end as Id_Driven_Bene , case when pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.Receiver_Id is null then 1 else 0 end as Nm_Driven_Bene , case when pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.Receiver_Id is null then pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM when pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null then pBene.extrl_ntity_type_cd ||'-'|| pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_ID when pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and t.Receiver_Id = pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID then pBene.extrl_ntity_type_cd||'-'||pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_ID else pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM end as Bene_Counter_Party , t.Trusted_Trans_Amt
from ( --BENEF to REM select t.REM_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as Sender_Id , t.REM_AUG_NM as Sender_Nm , t.REM_JRSDCN_CD as Sender_Jrsdcn_Cd , t.BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvy_Risk , t.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as Receiver_Id , t.BENEF_AUG_NM as Receiver_Nm , t.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD as Receiver_Jrsdcn_Cd --- , t.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL as Sender_Fl , t.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL as Receiver_Fl , 'Y' as Other_Receiver_Fl , -1 as Other_Receiver_Id , '-' as Other_Receiver_Nm , '-' as Other_Receiver_Jrsdcn_Cd ---- , t.TRXN_BASE_AM as Pair_Trans_Am , (CASE WHEN t.benef_actvy_risk_nb > @ACTVY_RISK_LVL THEN t.trxn_base_am ELSE 0 END) HR_AM , (CASE WHEN t.pass_thru_fl = 'Y' THEN t.trxn_base_am ELSE 0 END) PASS_THRU_AM , (CASE WHEN t.trxn_base_am - trunc(t.trxn_base_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN t.Clr_Trxn_Actvy_Am - trunc(t.clr_trxn_actvy_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.clr_trxn_actvy_am WHEN t.dep_trxn_Actvy_am - trunc(t.dep_trxn_actvy_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.dep_trxn_actvy_am WHEN t.issue_trxn_actvy_am - trunc(t.issue_trxn_actvy_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.issue_trxn_actvy_am ELSE 0 END) LRF_AM , t.DATA_DUMP_DT as Data_Dump_Date , (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') as Clndr_Dt , case when t.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' then t.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end as Trusted_Trans_Amt from mi_view t where t.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' and t.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y'
-------------------------------------------------- union all -------------------------------------------------- -- SCND BENEF to REM select t.REM_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as Sender_Id , t.REM_AUG_NM as Sender_Nm , t.REM_JRSDCN_CD as Sender_Jrsdcn_Cd , t.SCND_BENEF_ACTVY_RISK_NB as Actvy_Risk , t.SCND_BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as Receiver_Id , t.SCND_BENEF_AUG_NM as Receiver_Nm , t.SCND_BENEF_JRSDCN_CD as Receiver_Jrsdcn_Cd --- , t.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL as Sender_Fl , t.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL as Receiver_Fl , t.INTRL_BENEF_ACCT_FL as Other_Receiver_Fl , t.BENEF_EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID as Other_Receiver_Id , t.BENEF_AUG_NM as Other_Receiver_Nm , t.BENEF_JRSDCN_CD as Other_Receiver_Jrsdcn_Cd --- , t.TRXN_BASE_AM as Pair_Trans_Am ,(CASE WHEN t.scnd_benef_actvy_risk_nb > @ACTVY_RISK_LVL THEN t.trxn_base_am ELSE 0 END) HR_AM ,(CASE WHEN t.pass_thru_fl = 'Y' THEN t.trxn_base_am ELSE 0 END) PASS_THRU_AM ,(CASE WHEN t.trxn_base_am - trunc(t.trxn_base_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.TRXN_BASE_AM WHEN t.Clr_Trxn_Actvy_Am - trunc(t.clr_trxn_actvy_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.clr_trxn_actvy_am WHEN t.dep_trxn_Actvy_am - trunc(t.dep_trxn_actvy_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.dep_trxn_actvy_am WHEN t.issue_trxn_actvy_am - trunc(t.issue_trxn_actvy_am, -@LrfDigits) = 0 THEN t.issue_trxn_actvy_am ELSE 0 END) LRF_AM , t.DATA_DUMP_DT as Data_Dump_Date , (select k.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL k where k.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and k.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL') as Clndr_Dt , case when t.TRSTD_TRXN_FL = 'Y' then t.TRXN_BASE_AM else 0 end as Trusted_Trans_Amt from mi_view t where t.INTRL_REM_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' and t.INTRL_SCND_BENEF_ACCT_FL <> 'Y' -------------------------------------------------- ) t inner join @MINER@.external_entity pRem on (t.Sender_Id = pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (t.Sender_Nm = pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and t.Sender_Jrsdcn_Cd = pRem.JRSDCN_CD)) inner join @MINER@.external_entity pBene on (t.Receiver_Id = pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID or (t.Receiver_Nm = pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM and t.Receiver_Jrsdcn_Cd = pBene.JRSDCN_CD))
where -- exclude records where Sending Side = Receiving Side pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID <> pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID -- include transaction record where Receiver_Party <> Other_Receiver_Party .. i.e., the Bene and Secondary Bene are not same and ( t.Other_Receiver_Fl ='Y' or ( -- looking at second benef ID, make sure it's not same as benef ID (pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is null and COALESCE(t.Other_Receiver_Id, -1) <> t.Receiver_Id) or -- looking at second benef Name, make sure it's not same as benef name (pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_NM is not null and (COALESCE(t.Other_Receiver_Nm, '-') <> t.Receiver_Nm or COALESCE(t.Other_Receiver_Jrsdcn_Cd, '-') <> t.Receiver_Jrsdcn_Cd)) ) ) --OFSAABD-19206 --Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR pRem.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR pBene.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- 36818690 Exclude Exempted EN and pRem.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 and pBene.EXTRL_NTITY_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 )
select gt.Sender_Name as REM, gt.Sender_Seq_Id as REM_SEQ_ID, gt.Receiver_Name as BENEF, gt.Receiver_Seq_Id as BENEF_SEQ_ID, gt.Receiver_Seq_Id as EXTRL_NTITY_SEQ_ID, count(1) as TRXN_CT, sum(gt.Pair_Trans_Am) as TOT_TRXN_AM, max(gt.Effctv_Risk) as EFFCTV_RISK_NB, sum(gt.Pass_Thru_Am)/sum(gt.Pair_Trans_Am)*100 as Pass_Thru_Prctg, sum(gt.Lrf_Am)/sum(gt.Pair_Trans_Am)*100 as Lrf_Prctg, sum(gt.HR_Am)/sum(gt.Pair_Trans_Am)*100 as Hr_Prctg, max(gt.Data_Dump_Date) as DATA_DUMP_DT, max(gt.Actvy_Risk) as ACTVY_RISK_LVL, case when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) >= @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) >= @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then 'HR' when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) < @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) < @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then 'RR' else 'MR' end Overall_Risk, sum(gt.Trusted_Trans_Amt) as Trusted_Trans_Amt
from pairs gt
group by gt.Sender_Seq_Id, gt.Sender_Name, gt.Receiver_Seq_Id, gt.Receiver_Name having ( sum(gt.Id_Driven_Orig) = count(1) or count(distinct gt.Other_Id_Orig) > 1 or (sum(gt.Nm_Driven_Orig) = 1 and count(1) = 1) ) and ( sum(gt.Id_Driven_Bene) = count(1) or count(distinct gt.Other_Id_Bene) > 1 or (sum(gt.Nm_Driven_Bene) = 1 and count(1) = 1) )
and max(gt.Data_Dump_Date) > add_days(max(gt.CLNDR_DT), -@Frequency)
and ( count(1) >= (case when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) >= @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) >= @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then @HR_PMIN_CT when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) < @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) < @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then @RR_PMIN_CT else @MR_PMIN_CT end) or ( count(1) >= (case when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) >= @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) >= @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then @HR_SMIN_CT when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) < @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) < @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then @RR_SMIN_CT else @MR_SMIN_CT end) and sum(gt.Pair_Trans_Am) >= (case when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) >= @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) >= @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then @HR_SMIN_AM when max(gt.Effctv_Risk) < @EFCTV_RISK_LVL and max(gt.Actvy_Risk) < @ACTVY_RISK_LVL then @RR_SMIN_AM else @MR_SMIN_AM end) ) )
